scoring_justification: Agent reports extracted electronic properties; full recompute from raw DFT logs is infeasible. Paper's reported numeric values serve as hidden gold with tolerances.

outputs.description: Extracted electronic properties: impurity state energies relative to O 2p VBM, band gaps, and direct gap character for pure, C-doped, and P-doped ZnO.

output_contract.notes: Checkers will compare each numeric quantity to hidden paper-reported gold values with appropriate tolerances (impurity energies ±0.1 eV, band gaps ±0.05 eV) and exact boolean match for direct gap flags. Charge density plots are not required.

steps.note: Paper: isolated states at 0.4 eV above O 2p VBM for C-doped ZnO

Paper: GGA+U band gap of pure ZnO is 1.1 eV
Paper states no significant band gap narrowing; Fig. 5 shows C-doped gap ~1.1 eV
Paper states no significant band gap narrowing; P-doped gap also ~1.1 eV
Paper: pure ZnO has direct gap at Γ point
Paper: C-doping preserves direct gap at Γ
Paper: P-doping preserves direct gap at Γ

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for impurity state energies, band gaps, and direct-gap flags
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig. 5; explicit values: 'isolated states appear ... at 0.4 and 0.2 eV' (p.6), 'calculated value of pure ZnO band gap is 1.1 eV' (p.5). Doped band gaps inferred from 'no significant band gap narrowing' and Fig. 5.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers and statements.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact quantities the paper reports as its main electronic-structure results; they are traceable to specific sentences and figures.
